# Ravensholm Books — order pipeline journals

Orders flow through two stages: the storefront (checkout and payment) and
the fulfilment warehouse (pick, pack, label). Each stage writes its own
evening-shift journal; every record line names the order it belongs to in
an order= field.

- logs/storefront-2026-08-27.log — checkout stage. An order whose payment
